contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [---] PF AVG ; R/ [GLOR] IA EX [ERC]IT[VS]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust draped, diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---] PF AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them; a square vexillum may bear a crescent with horns upward, or perhaps an eagle with wings spread. Reverse inscription: [GLOR] IA EX [ERC]IT[VS]. Diameter: 15.3mm, Weight: 1.35gms, die axis: 12
